introduce: Start with your feet together and your arms by your sides, then jump up with your feet apart and your hands overhead. \n\nReturn to the start position then do the next rep. This exercise provides a full-body workout and works all your large muscle groups.
name: JUMPING JACKS

tips.text: Bend your arms to bring your hands over your head.
Start at a slow speed, then gradually increase the pace.
Your arms shouldn't be straight when you raise them above your head.
Inhale when your feet are apart, and exhale when pulling them back.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankles.
If you feel it's too easy, jump as high as you can.
Your back, glutes, abs, shoulders and calves all get involved.
It's a full body exercise to strengthen your cardiovascular system.

introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your right leg to the side at a 90 degree angle.
name: FIRE HYDRANT RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your arms straight.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
Always keep your core tight.
Don't arch your back.
Don't lift your leg higher than your torso.
Lift your leg as you exhale and lower it as you inhale.
If it's too easy for you, hold your leg up for several seconds.
You should feel your butt burning.
This exercise tones and firms up your butt and thighs.
This exercise can strengthen your hips and tighten your core.

introduce: Start on all fours with your knees under your butt and your hands under your shoulders. \n\nThen lift your left leg to the side at a 90 degree angle.
name: FIRE HYDRANT LEFT

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Keep your arms straight.
Keep your lifted leg at a 90 degree angle.
Always keep your core tight.
Don't arch your back.
Don't lift your leg higher than your torso.
Lift your leg as you exhale and lower it as you inhale.
If it's too easy for you, hold your leg up for several seconds.
You should feel your butt burning.
This exercise tones and firms up your butt and thighs.
This exercise can strengthen your hips and tighten your core.

introduce: Lie down on your side with your head rested on your left arm. Lift your upper leg up and return to the start position.\n\nMake sure your right leg goes straight up and down during the exercise. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus.
name: SIDE-LYING LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Your leg should go straight up and down.
Keep your legs straight.
Your toes should point forward.
Don't rotate your leg forward or backward.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
To get more of a challenge, add weight on your ankle.
Hold for a few seconds when lifting your leg.
This is a great exercise for your glutes and quadriceps.

introduce: Lie on your right side with head resting on your right hand. \n\nThen put your left foot forward on the floor. Lift your right leg up and down.
name: BOTTOM LEG LIFT RIGHT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Tighten your core.
Keep your upper body still.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
If you feel it's too easy, lift your leg as high as you can.
It works if you feel your bottom inner thigh burning.
This exercise is good for your inner thighs.

introduce: Lie on your left side with your head resting on your left hand. \n\nThen put your right foot forward on the floor. Lift your left leg up and down.
name: BOTTOM LEG LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Tighten your core.
Keep your upper body still.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering it.
If you feel it's too easy, lift your leg as high as you can.
It works if you feel your bottom inner thigh burning.
This exercise is good for your inner thighs.

introduce:
Lie on your back with arms at sides, palms down and legs extended. 

Lift your legs and cross the right thigh over the left, then reverse the exercise. 

Make sure your back is always flat.

It's a great exercise for the obliques and rectus abdominis.
name: SCISSORS

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Slightly bend your knees.
Breathe naturally.
To make it easier, place your hands under your glutes to get more balance.
This exercise primarily targets your lower abs.
This exercise can help you get great balance.

introduce:
Lie down on your side with your head rested on your right arm. Lift your upper leg up and return to the start position.

Make sure your left leg goes straight up and down during the exercise.

It's a great exercise for the gluteus.
name: SIDE-LYING LEG LIFT LEFT

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Your leg should go straight up and down.
Keep your legs straight.
Your toes should point forward.
Don't rotate your leg forward or backward.
Exhale when lifting your leg, and inhale when lowering.
To get more of a challenge, add weight on your ankle.
Hold for a few seconds when lifting your leg.
This is a great exercise for your glutes and quadriceps.

introduce: Start with your feet shoulder width apart. Bend your legs slightly and lean your upper body forward. \n\nPut your hands in front of you to keep balance, then run in place quickly.
name: QUICK FEET

tips.text: Keep your upper body still.
Keep your core tight.
Take steady and deep breaths.
To make it harder, do the quick steps as fast as you can.
You can feel your heart rate up.
Maintain steady, controlled breathing throughout the exercise.
This exercise targets your quadriceps and calves.
It's a great exercise to improve your speed and agility.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wide distance apart and your hands rested on your hips. 

Then bend your left leg and lean your body to the left side. 

Hold the position for a few seconds, then return and repeat with the other side.
name: ADDUCTOR STRETCH IN STANDING

tips.text: Shift your weight away from the stretched leg until you feel the stretch in your inner thigh.
Squeeze the butt of the stretching side to increase the stretch.
Your feet should point straight forward.
Please don't rotate your feet out.
Exhale as you lower your body, and keep breathing normally as you hold the stretch.
You should feel stretch in the inner thigh of the stretching leg.
This exercise can stretch your inner thighs.

introduce: Stand up on the floor, then run in place while kicking your heel up to touch your butt with each step.\n\nTry to do it as fast as you can. It\'s a great exercise for the gluteus and hamstrings.
name: BUTT KICKS

tips.text: Please keep your chest up.
Please try to get your feet to touch your hips.
Please pull your shoulders back.
Please tighten your abs.
Please land on your toes.
Please try to do it as fast as you can.
Try to maintain a steady, rhythmic breathing pattern throughout the exercise.
Always remember to inhale deeply through the nose and exhale fully through the mouth.
It’s a cardio exercise that can strengthen your gluteus and hamstrings.

introduce:
Sit on the floor with your legs bent together and your hands under your shoulders to support your body. 

Then lift one leg up while lifting your hips off the floor as high as you can. Switch to the other leg and repeat.

Push yourself up with your hips instead of your back. It's a great exercise for the gluteus.
name: CRAB KICKS

tips.text: Please push yourself up with your hips instead of your back.
Please lift your hips off the floor as high as you can.
To make it more of a challenge, you can alternately kick your feet in the air.
Exhale as you lift your body up and kick your legs out.
Inhale as you bring your legs back in and lower your body.
This exercise works the back of your thighs, your shoulders, your abs, and especially your gluteus.

introduce:
Stand with your feet 1.5 times shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing outward. Place your hands by your sides.

Lower your body until your thighs are parallel to the floor. And bring your hands together in front of your chest.

Return to the starting position and repeat the exercise.
name: SUMO SQUAT

tips.text: Keep your core tight.
Keep your chest up and back straight.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale when you go down, and exhale when you go up.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hand.
This exercise targets all the muscles of your lower body.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your left knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your left knee towards your chest, keeping your right leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your right knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your right knee towards your chest, keeping your left leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart. Bend your arms in front of you to keep balance. \n\nLower your body until your thighs are parallel with the floor. Come half way up instead of coming all the way up, then squat down again. Repeat.
name: SQUAT PULSES

tips.text: Your knees should be extended in the same direction as your toes.
Squeeze your gluteus.
Your knees should not go over your toes.
Inhale through your nose and exhale through the mouth.
Breathe in a regular pattern according to your cadence.
If you feel it's too easy, hold a dumbbell in your hands.
You should feel your glutes really on fire.
Please keep your back straight.

introduce: Lay prone on the ground with arms supporting your body. Hop forward, bring your knees toward your chest, then hop back to the starting position. Repeat the exercise.
name: IN & OUTS

tips.text: Please do this workout on a mat.
Exhale as you hop forward, and inhale as you hop back.
This cardio exercise helps burn body fat and strengthen your core.
